title: Required time-window check cannot execute because its stage never completed, synthetic
scientific_question: Illustrative only (SYNTHETIC): were five invented water samples at two fictional stations collected inside the requested time window? No real question is being answered.
claim_tested: Given a manifest with four required checks, where the evidence for the fourth (fixtures/time/events.json) was never written because its stage never completed, science-gate verify does not report PASS: it returns ABSTAIN (exit 2) with primary reason PARTIAL_EXECUTION and failure mode PARTIAL_EXECUTION only, and its report states checks_executed=3 of checks_expected=4 and names the unexecuted check and its missing file.
falsified_by: science-gate returns PASS or exit code 0; or it presents the three passing checks as a complete run; or it does not name the time-window check or the missing file; or its primary reason is not PARTIAL_EXECUTION.

known_failures: Recorded run's primary reason is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not the intended PARTIAL_EXECUTION (science-gate 0.1.0, commit 7ec36c6; reasons ['INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE', 'PARTIAL_EXECUTION']). science-gate's decision precedence (ARCHITECTURE.md section 6) takes the primary reason from the first finding in the order manifest, inputs, checks, contract, invariants. The skipped check's own finding (time_sources MISSING, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) comes before the contract finding 'checks_executed=3 of checks_expected=4' (PARTIAL_EXECUTION). Status, exit code, failure_modes and every must_mention string match.

The recorded report lists the invariant every_required_check_has_terminal_state as holding ('4 required check(s) each reached a terminal state'). In science-gate's vocabulary a SKIPPED check whose ledger invocation closed as ABSTAINED is terminal, so the category's 'never reached a terminal state' is detected only through the checks_executed counter, not through that invariant.

Recorded run (science-gate commit e563fd3, 2026-10-28) reports failure_modes ['OMITTED_POPULATION'], not the intended ['PARTIAL_EXECUTION']. The time-window check is SKIPPED with the closed-vocabulary label INPUT_UNAVAILABLE (missing time_sources document; ARCHITECTURE.md 17.7), and G2 maps that label to ABSTAIN / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / OMITTED_POPULATION, so no PARTIAL_EXECUTION finding is made. Status ABSTAIN and exit code 2 match; the primary reason is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, as documented above. See unresolved_cases.

Recorded report.md (commit e563fd3) does not contain the must_mention string 'PARTIAL_EXECUTION': with a labelled skip the run's only reason is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and its only failure mode OMITTED_POPULATION, so the report never names PARTIAL_EXECUTION. The other must_mention strings (checks_executed=3 of checks_expected=4, fixtures/time/events.json, time-window) match.
unresolved_cases: Whether the primary reason should name the cause of the skip (missing evidence: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) or its consequence (a required check did not execute: PARTIAL_EXECUTION). This entry takes the second position because the unexecuted check is the defect the category exercises; science-gate takes the first.

science-gate verify cannot take an externally recorded execution ledger as input, so a check that literally started and never finished (a STARTED ledger entry with no terminal entry) cannot be presented to verify. This entry approximates the category with a required check that could not execute. According to science-gate's documentation and code (not exercised here), a literally unterminated invocation arises only in a science-gate run directory, where `science-gate report` treats it as a re-verification failure (ERROR), or through the ledger mutations M16 and M17.

coverage-debt-synthetic-01 intends the cause (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) as the primary reason for a run with the same reasons [INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, PARTIAL_EXECUTION] and the same contract finding checks_executed=3 of checks_expected=4; there the fourth check is NOT_APPLICABLE instead of SKIPPED. The corpus states no rule that separates the two cases. A reviewer must decide whether both positions stand; neither expected outcome has been edited.

Spec contradiction, needs a gate or spec decision (recorded 2026-10-28 as a documented gap, owner-approved on 2026-10-28): ARCHITECTURE.md 17.7 G2 re-baselines this entry to 'an unlabelled skip', FAIL / PARTIAL_EXECUTION, but the label rules of the same section (around lines 788-803) give every verify skip path a closed-vocabulary label: Findings.not_applicable requires one, document_unavailable gives INPUT_UNAVAILABLE (EVIDENCE_MALFORMED for a parse error), malformed_document EVIDENCE_MALFORMED, _no_rows_to_examine NOT_DECLARED, SOURCE_REJECTED, INPUT_UNAVAILABLE or EMPTY_POPULATION, and the citations, claims, assertions, dependencies and mutation_accounting helpers label theirs; a check that raises becomes ERROR, which G2 excludes. A missing document is INPUT_UNAVAILABLE, which SKIP_JUSTIFICATION_OUTCOMES maps to ABSTAIN / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / OMITTED_POPULATION. So no fixture can produce FAIL / PARTIAL_EXECUTION through `verify`; the only unlabelled SKIPPED result in the source is mutations.skipped_checker, the M15 stand-in used by `mutate`, and the gate's own test of the unlabelled case (tests/test_verdict_lattice.py) uses a test-only check. The intended outcome is kept unchanged and the divergence is marked expectedFailure through DOCUMENTED_GAPS rows for failure_modes and for must_mention PARTIAL_EXECUTION (and the existing reason row). The old intended ABSTAIN / PARTIAL_EXECUTION is unreachable as well, since no label maps to PARTIAL_EXECUTION.
